long_biography.plain_text:
Čolak’s relationship with FEAL predates his succession to the main company. For more than a decade, he chaired FEAL Croatia’s supervisory board, while the construction subsidiary FEAL IN also operated under his ownership. Those positions placed him inside the group’s governance and development activities before its founder died.

After Jozo Bogdan’s death, Čolak joined the ownership of the Široki Brijeg parent in November 2021. FEAL now identifies him as its owner, with professional directors handling operating management. The company produces aluminium profiles and architectural systems and exports most of its output. Čolak has also pursued development projects through Croatian companies, but FEAL remains the clearest centre of his business identity.

Bosnian and Croatian public sources consistently preserve the surname as Čolak. The source record and LinkedIn omit the diacritic, likely as an ASCII rendering, so the canonical display, last-name and sort corrections are proposed while the immutable dossier owner label remains unchanged.

A local electoral-roll result contains a same-name date, but it does not independently bridge the entry to FEAL strongly enough for enrichment and presents unnecessary personal-data sensitivity. Birth day, month, year and place remain blank.

Čolak previously chaired a group supervisory board and now represents FEAL publicly as owner, but maintained company and government accounts name separate executives for general and production management. Heir / family shareholder is therefore better supported than Operator.

Čolak has supported construction and development interests, but FEAL's regional aluminium-manufacturing platform is the clearest and largest identifiable current holding. Manufacturing is used for both industry fields rather than Diversified.

The existing LinkedIn is verified by its exact FEAL and Bosnia alignment and requires no proposal. Company channels are not substituted for personal accounts.

Construction materials is the single minimum useful active tag because FEAL's aluminium profiles and building systems are Čolak's defining present holding. Generic manufacturing, real estate, construction, energy and hospitality tags would be broader, duplicative or insufficiently weighted.
